name: Apex robotics follow-up
notes: Nina jumped on from her personal calendar after the Apex Enterprise thread. She wanted to confirm Thursday's demo still holds and to share a Clari question she didn't want on the work thread. Same Enterprise evaluation as the earlier follow-up with Chris.

action_items.text: Keep Thursday's Enterprise demo on the calendar; send Nina the agenda on her work email as well

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Nina — I saw this hold come through on a Gmail invite. Just us?

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Yeah, sorry. I'm Nina Volk, I'm still at Apex Robotics. I didn't want to put this on the work calendar because Chris forwards everything. I'm on my personal email today. Same Enterprise conversation as Tuesday, not a new company.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Got it. We're still on the Apex Enterprise follow-up, just a quieter channel. Thursday's demo still good?

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Thursday is still the next step. Chris added Maya. I wanted to flag something I didn't say in front of him. One of our directors is pushing Clari harder than I let on. He used it at Snowflake. If Thursday is only a product tour, he'll say we already know the category.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Then Thursday should open with the manager override, not a homepage. We can show how a commit changes in the meeting instead of in a Clari-style waterfall after the fact.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: That's what I needed. I'm the same Nina you've been working with — Volk, Apex Robotics, Enterprise seats, Chris Hale on the thread. I barely check this Gmail; it's just how I grabbed thirty minutes while I was out.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: I'll keep sending Apex mail to nina at apexrobotics. This is just how you grabbed thirty minutes. Anything else from the Enterprise thread I should know before Thursday?

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: IT asked for the SOC 2. I forwarded the trust center link. Procurement is not in the demo. If they join later it's a paper process, not a second evaluation. We're not kicking off a robotics-wide RFP. This is still Enterprise, the open one.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: Clear. I'll send the Thursday agenda to your Apex address and copy Chris. If the Clari director joins, we'll have the side-by-side ready.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: He might. His name is Raj. He will ask about historical snapshots. If you can show a week-over-week commit without exporting to Sheets, that helps me internally.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: We can. I'll add a two-minute snapshot clip so we don't spend the hour on it. Thanks for the heads-up, Nina. I'll see you Thursday with Chris and Maya.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: See you then. And thanks for not making me explain who I am from a Gmail address for twenty minutes.

transcript.speaker: Priya Shah
transcript.text: You're still Nina at Apex. Talk Thursday. I'll send the agenda to work email as soon as I'm off this call.

transcript.speaker: Nina Volk
transcript.text: Perfect. If Raj joins Thursday I'll warn you in Slack from my Apex handle, not this Gmail.
